_readme: Crew supplies: food, water and air for the crew on the ship. They are a separate group from the six resources, and show only in Flight and Arrival. per_person_per_day = how much ONE person uses in ONE day (real NASA numbers, with the quote and link in each source). The game multiplies it by crew_size and by the game days that pass. Every fact is written as { "value": ..., "source": ... }. A source is a NASA link or the word PLACEHOLDER (made up for now; a student replaces it before the final submission). start_amount = what the ship carries at the start. capacity = the most a meter can hold (the bar's full size). A meter turns yellow below warning_percent of its capacity and red below danger_percent. Tasks: rationing slows how fast food drops, running the oxygen generator makes oxygen (air goes up), changing the water filter gives water back, and harvesting the garden (only with the Garden life support part) gives food. A better timed press gives more. Which tasks are in which Flight leg is in events.json flight_plan. In Arrival the crew uses the real daily amounts for all the days of the mission clock (about 730). The start amounts and capacities are made up (PLACEHOLDER) so that a player who does the Flight tasks stays out of the red. The water leak is in events.json. The words on the screen are in data/story.json and data/inner_voice.json.

food.source: Lopez, Schultz et al., Logistics Needs for Potential Deep Space Mission Scenarios Post Asteroid Redirect Crewed Mission, NASA Johnson Space Center, Table Food/Crew Provisions: 'Food Kg/crew/day 1.831 BVAD Table & ISS experience' (includes packaging). https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20150003005/downloads/20150003005.pdf

water.source: NASA-STD-3001 Technical Brief OCHMO-TB-027 Water: 'Potable Water for Hydration Minimum 2.5 L (84.5 fl oz) per crewmember per day'. https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/ochmo-tb-027-water.pdf

air.source: Lopez, Schultz et al. (same paper), Table Gases: 'O 2 Metabolic kg per crew/day 0.82 HIDH / BVAD'. https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20150003005/downloads/20150003005.pdf
